raw_text: I ordered a Samsung TV last week and the delivery status says delivered but I never received it. My neighbor also confirmed nothing was left at the door. This is completely unacceptable. I want a full refund immediately. Order ID is ORD-78234.

I bought a pair of Nike shoes 35 days ago and I want to return them. The size is slightly wrong but I couldn't try them earlier because I was traveling. I see the return window is 30 days but it's only 5 days over. Can you please make an exception? Order ORD-65891.

The laptop I received has a cracked screen. The box was also damaged when it arrived. I have photos. I paid Rs. 89,000 for this and this is the condition it came in?? I want a replacement or full refund. This is absolutely disgusting service. Order number ORD-91023.

I ordered a blue shirt size L (ORD-44567) but received a red shirt size M. This is a wrong item. I need the correct item delivered before this weekend as it was for an event. Please arrange pickup of this wrong item and deliver the correct one urgently.

I returned my phone 10 days ago and I still haven't received my refund. I was told it would take 5-7 business days. The return was picked up and the status shows received at warehouse. Where is my Rs. 45,000 refund? This is my third email about this.
